coverage_claim: Bounded extraction pass on one resource, cutoff 2026-11-15. The pinned artifacts are the official repository at commit 6d1ca744fa8ed285edafae7b98da65205bf00fd3 and the Hugging Face weights repository at revision dd4b0c1b69984b68edcb6200a544213be4d75242. Not systematic exhaustion, no claim about third-party evaluations of BioEmu-2, and no claim about work outside the queries listed.
decision: Extracted one model record for BioEmu-2, five configuration records (the released checkpoint, the inference package with its two CUDA install paths, and the structure, equilibrium and propagation modes), thirteen source records and seventy-five descriptive claims into data/omics/bioemu2-20261115/batch.jsonl. No evaluation or result record was written: no pinned artifact prints a numeric evaluation value. No benchmark or dataset record was written either, because the evaluation settings are described without published targets, baselines or metric definitions, and the MD holdout is drawn from the training data.
excluded: runtimewire.com news items about the BioEmu2 weight release (English, Japanese and Chinese versions): secondary reporting, not a primary source.
Third-party Hugging Face copies of the weights (sekkit/bioemu2, OxBee/bioemu2, fengzhimu/bioemu2, BioJazz-Lab/bioemu2): mirrors, not the official repository.
The 20 October 2026 X thread cited by a news item as the announcement: no URL or author was verified, so it is recorded as an unverified lead and supports nothing.
Microsoft Research Focus podcast page naming BioEmu2 as available in public preview: secondary, undated on the page itself, and adds nothing the model card does not state.

BioEmu (the 2025 model: Science July 2025 and Nature Methods s41592-025-02874-1): a different model. The BioEmu-2 artifacts name no predecessor, so no relationship was recorded and no BioEmu record was created here.
OriDynamics (arXiv:2611.11958), which names BioEmu2 as a baseline: a third-party evaluation outside this extraction, kept as a lead for a separate pass.
Fold-CP (arXiv:2603.14806), cited by the context-parallel guide as background: a method reference, not evidence about BioEmu-2.
failed_candidates: No paper, preprint or technical report for BioEmu-2 was found. The pinned tree at the commit holds no CITATION file, the README has no citation section, and the model card cites no publication. Searches for an arXiv entry and for a Microsoft Research publication page returned only the earlier BioEmu papers and third-party work. Recorded as a gap, not as a claim that none exists.
gaps: The model card describes four evaluation settings (folding on the Boltz-1 test set, author-curated paired PDB conformations, MD emulation on a holdout of the training MD datasets, and large complexes over 1,500 tokens) but prints no numeric value for any of them, so no result record exists. The two context-parallel throughput figures are images with no printed numbers.
The evaluated checkpoint is not named: the model card says the same checkpoint was used for every benchmark, and only docs/checkpoints.md names bioemu2-preview, as the default download.
No baseline is named for the folding comparison, which the model card describes only as a range of state-of-the-art cofolding models.
The curated paired-conformation subset and the MD holdout are not published or sized in the pinned artifacts.
The model card and the README at the same commit disagree about the smallest tested GPU, and no memory figure is printed for any system size, so no single minimum device is recorded.
The checkpoint bytes (2,047,661,181) were not downloaded; the recorded digest is the one the Git LFS pointer publishes.
No paper or technical report was found, so there is no peer-reviewed or preprint account of the architecture, training or evaluation.
